ns2:section.sectionText: Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply; see http://www.outreach.uiuc.edu. This site-based course is for students in the EOL Oak Brook SELP (Ed Admin) Doctoral cohort. Class sessions will be held at the Oak Brook Multi University Center on Wednesdays, Jan 21 to Apr 29; 5:30 to 9:30pm (no class on Mar 25 and Apr 15). This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veteransø grants, etc.) and waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC. The waiver policy above is subject to moderate changes in accordance with the actions of the University of Illinois Board of Trustees.
